snippet.title: Mixed Spirits: Bartender Simulator - Run A Cozy Bar - Gameplay Teaser (Steam)
snippet.description:
Run a cozy bar, make cocktails for fun customers! 🍸 Mixed Spirits is a Job Simulator where you work as a bartender. Take orders, mix custom drinks, and discover secret recipes in a chill, creative night-shift experience with no timers or stress, or rush orders in Happy Hour mode!

Wishlist on Steam to be notified when the free demo is out! https://store.steampowered.com/app/3891400/Mixed_Spirits_Bartender_Simulator/
